- Select and copy text in the preview window, PDF pages included
- Scroll through the pages of a PDF in the preview; long PDFs load faster
- A rename is confirmed when you click outside the name field
- New app icon
- Drag folders from history into favorites, and drag shortcuts out to remove them
- Choose preview text by whole words
- Share files with other file managers through the clipboard on Linux
- Shortcuts started while typing a filter now work as expected
- Space shows the preview while a Neovim filter is typed
- Settings shows whether you are running a release or a pre-release
